title: populus fremontii subsp. wislizeni
intro: Populus fremontii subsp. wislizeni, commonly known as the Arizona cottonwood or Rio Grande cottonwood, is a subspecies of deciduous tree in the willow family (Salicaceae). The health benefits of Populus fremontii subsp. wislizeni include its ability to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing due to its antimicrobial and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use as an anti-inflammatory agent, which can help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and other inflammatory diseases. The bioactive constituents of Populus fremontii subsp. wislizeni include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
